About Us

Trusted Healthcare,
Delivered Globally

Founded in 2017 and backed by over 30 years of pharmaceutical expertise, Lilium International has become a trusted force in healthcare manufacturing, wholesale, and distribution across Africa and Asia.

We manufacture medications, medicinal products, and dietary supplements — distributing them across more than 12 countries. With a deep presence across Africa, we have pioneered solutions to combat malaria, infections, and other endemic health challenges that affect millions each year.

Our head office is in Mumbai, India, with a manufacturing facility in Nigeria — positioning us at the heart of two of the world's most dynamic pharmaceutical growth markets.

Our Commitment

Built on Three Core Pillars

✦
Quality

Every product that leaves our facility meets the highest pharmaceutical standards — manufactured with precision, consistency, and full regulatory compliance.

◈
Affordability

Healthcare should not be a privilege. We price our products so communities across Africa and beyond can access essential medicines without barrier.

⬡
Availability

Round-the-clock distribution networks ensure our products reach patients whenever and wherever they are needed — especially in underserved markets.

From The CEO

A Letter From
Our Founder

At Lilium International, we do not see borders — we see lives, voices, and futures waiting to be empowered by better health. Our commitment has always gone beyond products. We are here to reshape access, restore dignity through care, and make health and happiness a shared reality for all.

Our presence today across Nigeria, Ghana, Egypt, Mali, Cameroon, Chad, South Sudan, Central African Republic, Afghanistan, Uzbekistan, and India is not just business growth — it is a signal of trust earned by showing up, staying present, and solving real problems every day.

Our approach is simple: people first. Every partnership we build, every clinic we support, and every medicine we deliver is driven by one belief — that no one should be left behind. We don't promise perfection. But we promise presence. We promise progress.

Pramod Singh Chief Executive Officer — Lilium International
Our Mission
"To improve health and happiness by building systems that bring care closer — to homes, to communities, and to those too often left behind."

We are pained by the suffering that preventable disease continues to cause across Africa. That conviction drives our relentless investment in manufacturing better, more accessible medicines — and distributing them where they matter most.
